documentLessons.lesson: BP report has 3 columns: 2025, 2024, 2023. ALWAYS extract the 2025 (leftmost/first) column values. The system detects period as 2024 but the correct period is 2025.
Coca-Cola CF has 3 columns: 2024, 2023, 2022. Extract 2024 values (first column). Operating CF=6805, Investing=2524 (positive in 2024), Financing=-6910.
BMW CF: investing activities are NEGATIVE (outflow), e.g. -11369. Financing activities were POSITIVE in 2024 = 5766. Do not flip signs.
Values must be returned as integers in the document native scaling. If document says "in millions" and shows 267,732 — return 267732 NOT 267.732. Do NOT convert between scaling units.

promptImprovements.improvement: Return values as whole numbers in the document native unit. If scaling=millions and document shows 267,732 return 267732. Never divide by 1000 to convert units.
For CF investing activities: outflows are NEGATIVE. If document shows "(11,369)" or "-11,369" return -11369. For financing: check the sign in the document.
When document has multiple year columns (e.g. 2025, 2024, 2023), ALWAYS extract the MOST RECENT year (first/leftmost data column).
